hyperedges.label: Production service pages unified design system

attributes.context: All four production service pages share the same custom CSS design system with Cormorant Garamond headlines, DM Sans body, and the 5-color restricted palette (ink, gold, parchment, fog, body). They share identical nav, footer, Schema.org patterns, and visual structure.

All three Tailwind CSS prototypes implement the Heritage Excellence design system defined in DESIGN.md. They share Montserrat/Libre Franklin/Inter typography, deep-navy and accent-gold color palette, and represent the proposal/exploration phase before production.

These documents together form the strategic foundation for the Consultores Vega website redesign: original content (datos_web), creative brief (seo_cro), strategy proposal (estrategia), and design system (Heritage Excellence). They inform all subsequent prototype and production pages.

hyperedges.label: Shared Design System Across All Pages

attributes.description: Design system specification for Heritage Excellence theme. YAML front matter defines colors (deep-navy #06182C, accent-gold-light #E5D1A1), typography (Montserrat headlines, Libre Franklin body, Inter labels), 8px spacing unit, 1200px container. This is the earlier design iteration before the production system evolved to use Cormorant Garamond and DM Sans.
Chilean Internal Revenue Service. Referenced across tax-related service pages as the regulatory authority for monthly and annual tax declarations.
Chilean labor authority. Referenced in context of payroll compliance and labor law obligations.

Chilean professional services firm (Consultores Vega Ltda.) founded in Valparaiso in 1947 by Issac Vega Duran. Currently based in Vina del Mar at Alvarez 1136 oficina D. Multidisciplinary team: Contador Auditor, Ingeniero Comercial MBA, Ingeniero Civil Industrial MBA, Ingeniero Informatico. Registered with SVS since 1991 and Corte de Apelaciones de Valparaiso since 1978.
Comision para el Mercado Financiero (formerly Superintendencia de Valores y Seguros). Chilean financial market regulator. Consultores Vega registered in their external auditor registry since 1991.
Committee of Sponsoring Organizations framework for internal control evaluation. Referenced as the methodological basis for Consultores Vega control interno service.

Director Gerente and current proprietor of Consultores Vega. Joined as Contador General in 1976. Contador Auditor from P. Universidad Catolica de Valparaiso. Registered with SVS since 1991 and as Perito in Corte de Apelaciones de Valparaiso since 1978.

attributes.description: Full SEO/CRO prompt and creative brief. Details target audience (PYMES, gerentes, SpA), brand values (trayectoria desde 1947, confianza), tone guidelines, and complete original website content for rewriting.
Optimized version of the services page prototype. Same Heritage Excellence theme. Adds FAQ accordion pattern with custom JS transitions. Performance-focused iteration of the services page.

Production service page for business valuations, due diligence, and DCF analysis. Uses FinancialService Schema.org type. Mentions CMF/SVS registration as trust signal. Same production design system as other service pages.

Production service page for evaluacion de control interno (internal control evaluation). Uses custom design system with Cormorant Garamond and DM Sans fonts. Contains Schema.org JSON-LD with FAQPage and BreadcrumbList structured data. References COSO framework for internal controls methodology.
Production service page for monthly tax services including IVA, PPM, and F29 form preparation. Uses TaxPreparationService Schema.org type. PriceRange CLP 400000-800000. Includes Offer schema.

Production service page for payroll services (remuneraciones). PriceRange CLP 500000-1500000. Area served includes Quilpue and Villa Alemana beyond core Vina del Mar/Valparaiso. Contains ProfessionalService schema.
Raw content scrape of the original Consultores Vega website. Contains company history, service descriptions, contact information, and business hours. Source material for the website redesign project.

Strategic proposal defining SEO local positioning (keywords: Contadores en Vina del Mar, Auditoria Tributaria Valparaiso), web architecture (Home, Quienes Somos, Services pillars, Contacto), CRO goals (WhatsApp flotante, formularios breves), and a 20-topic content plan.

Tailwind CSS prototype of the homepage. Implements Heritage Excellence design system. Contains hero section with Excelencia desde 1947 badge. Early-stage design exploration before production implementation.
Tailwind CSS prototype of the services page. Uses flip-card interaction pattern for service cards. Implements Heritage Excellence theme with Montserrat, Libre Franklin, and Inter fonts.
Terms of Use legal page. References Consultores Vega Ltda as legal entity. Chilean law jurisdiction in Vina del Mar. Links to politica-privacidad. Simpler page without inline critical CSS.

The evolved production design system used across all service pages. Uses Cormorant Garamond and DM Sans fonts instead of the Heritage Excellence prototype fonts. Employs a restricted 5-color CSS custom property palette (ink, gold, parchment, fog, body). Represents the final design direction after the Heritage Excellence prototype phase.

nodes.label: Consultores Vega Design System
nodes.rationale: 5-color restricted palette with heritage gold accent and deep navy primary. Cormorant Garamond for display typography, DM Sans for UI. Self-hosted fonts to eliminate Google Fonts critical chain dependency. Intentional motion system with reduced-motion support.
